gold_sql: SELECT sum(Population) , GovernmentForm FROM country GROUP BY GovernmentForm HAVING avg(LifeExpectancy) > 79

question: Find the cities that have more than one employee under age 39.

question: What are the names of all stadiums that did not have a concert in 2021?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM stadium EXCEPT SELECT T2.name FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id = T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.year = 2021

question: What are the names of high schoolers who have a grade of over 10 and have 2 or more friends?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.id WHERE T2.grade > 10 GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*) >= 2
